projects of that L.L.C. Effective December 31, 2012, | returned, transferred, and quitclaimed all of my interest in Perkins Real Estate Ventures, L.L.C. for no

consideration. | have not yet received my 2012 Final K-1 for this L.L.C. and have been told that it will not likely be ready until August 2013. Thus, my entry of
